items.q: Well, I go^t along with him because I didn't have anything to say to him

ctx.x: Well, I go^t along with him because I didn't have anything to say to him, you know. He just talked to Louis, and that's all. The side men had no reason to talk to him. So our little Shangri-La was in Louis' dressing room, you know. And I never was too much on table hopping, because people could come out with some of the damndest questions, you know. Where were you born? When did you start playing? Do you come from a musical family? So and so, you know.
Who did you work there with?
